title: add-benchmark-lab-end-to-end-reporting-pipeline-v58
author: Priya Singh
description: Motivation: add end-to-end reporting pipeline for Benchmark Lab to consolidate profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and nightly reporting into a single, versioned pipeline. This PR introduces a new orchestrator job, incremental uploaders, and lightweight HTML report generation to reduce manual aggregation work and improve traceability. What changed: - New job: benchmark_lab_reporting_v58 (Airflow DAG + k8s job wrapper). - Runner changes: representative workload runners emit standardized metadata and trace IDs. - Profiling baselines: added nightly baseline snapshotter and checksum validation. - Reporting: aggregated JSON -> HTML renderer with per-model/per-hardware breakdown and CSV export for PMs. Checklist: - [x] DAG + k8s job definitions - [x] Runner payload schema and versioning - [x] Baseline snapshotting + checksum - [x] HTML report template and static assets - [x] End-to-end tests against staging cluster - [x] Documentation and quickstart Note: This is a backward-compatible rollout; new reporters default to disabled via config flag (benchmark_lab.reporting.v58.enabled=false) and will be enabled for the staging account for validation before wide rollout.
commit_summary: Squash of multiple commits: initial DAG and k8s wrapper; runner metadata + trace-id propagation; profiling snapshotter + checksum; report renderer and template; CI fixes and test additions. See commits: - add airflow DAG for benchmark_lab_reporting_v58 - add k8s job wrapper and RBAC rules - standardize runner payload metadata (versioned) - add baseline snapshotter and checksum validation - add report renderer and html template - add end-to-end tests and fixtures - fix linter/ci issues
review_comments: Luca Moreno: Please add a short migration note for older runners that don't emit trace IDs. Jasmine Park: Can we gate the nightly snapshotter behind account-level opt-in? Author (Priya Singh): Addressed both - added migration_section and opt-in flag (enabled only for staging by default). Ethan Brooks: Approve after CI green and one minor nit on docs. Priya Singh: PTAL again, fixed doc wording and added unit test for payload backward compatibility. CI re-run successful and reviewer approved.

release_notes: - Add benchmark lab end-to-end reporting pipeline (v58): consolidated reporting DAG, runner metadata versioning, profiling baseline snapshots, HTML/CSV renderer and staging rollout. - Backward compatible: older runners will continue to work; enable new pipeline via config flag.
